Hero.title: The <important>AI with no limits</important>. No filters, no censorship, no excuses.
Hero.description: Brujo IA gives you private access to uncensored AI models to write, create images and explore any idea, without a corporate filter deciding what you can ask. Pay with PayPhone in seconds.

Features.section_title: Everything an AI should let you do
Features.section_description: Powered by Venice.ai's private, uncensored models. Your prompts are not stored or used for training.
Features.feature1_description: Write stories, scripts, copy or code without refusals or moralizing. The model answers what you ask.
Features.feature2_description: Generate high-resolution images from any prompt, with no watermark and no content filter.
Features.feature3_description: Your prompts and results are processed privately and never used to train models.
Features.feature4_description: No international cards required. Pay in USD with PayPhone, the local payment gateway.
Features.feature5_description: Your PRO plan activates the moment PayPhone confirms the payment. No waiting.
Features.feature6_description: One payment, 30 days of PRO. Renew whenever you want, nothing charges automatically.

FAQ.answer5: Text of any kind (stories, scripts, code, copy) and high-resolution images from a text prompt.
FAQ.question6: What happens if my payment fails?
FAQ.answer6: Nothing is charged. You can retry from your dashboard or write to us at support.
